verdict.rationale: Canny documents a public changelog product for announcing what shipped. The staging-workspace doc also notes each workspace has its own subdomain and changelog. Nothing in the pack shows custom-domain hosting or full branding control of the changelog page. missing for 10: custom domain support for the changelog, branding/theming controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can serve a fully branded public changelog page on a custom domain

citations.quote: Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
